Each of the 10 boss species gains exactly one bespoke NON-PROJECTILE signature mechanic in addition to its existing 3-attack projectile rotation; the signature is a separate code path from `BOSS_SPECIALS`/`triggerBossSpecial` (which fire `enemyShots` bolts).\n8\t2. The existing 3-attack `BOSS_SPECIALS` rotation, `_specialIdx` cycling, `_specialCD`/`_baseCD` timing, `_atkFlash` telegraph, `spawnBossMinion` (4-minion cap), the 50%-HP rage phase (speed ×1.4, `leapEvery` ×0.7, `swoopSpeed` ×1.3, `_specialCD` ×0.65, orange aura/ring, \"ENRAGED\" HP-bar label), and the exit-lock behavior (`isBossAlive` gating `checkExit`) remain unchanged in observable behavior.\n9\t3. Every signature mechanic shows a visible in-canvas telegraph for at least 0.3 seconds before its first damaging moment occurs.\n10\t4. Every signature mechanic is avoidable using only base movement (run + double jump at base stats) with no purchased upgrades; signatures never clamp, teleport, or trap the player.\n11\t5. Every signature mechanic that can damage the player routes that damage through the existing `hurtPlayer` path so it respects `player.invuln` i-frames (`INVULN_TIME=0.9`), sets `player.hurtFlash`, applies knockback, and kills only when `player.hp` reaches 0.\n12\t6. The boss never leaves the arena: any boss movement caused by a signature stays clamped to `[e.patrolMin, e.patrolMax]`, exactly as the existing `boss`/slide behavior does.\n13\t7. slime signature `split`: the first time the boss drops to or below 50% HP, in addition to entering rage it spawns 2 mini-slime minions (one each side of the arena) via the existing `spawnBossMinion`/minion-template path; the split fires at most once per boss life (`_split` flag).\n14\t8. crawler signature `burrow`: on a per-boss timer the crawler telegraphs by dropping a dust marker (a tracked zone) at the player's current x for ≥0.4s, becomes non-collidable while underground, then re-emerges at that marked x; the marker x is captured at telegraph start so the player can step off it.\n15\t9. slider signature `iceTrail`: while `_sliding` (its existing ice-dash special), the slider leaves a tracked ice-trail zone along the arena floor; if the player stands on a live ice-trail zone their idle friction is overridden toward slippery for a capped duration `player.iceSlipT` (≤2.5s), and friction returns to `getStageModifier().fric` when the timer expires or the player leaves all trail zones for that duration.\n16\t10. scorpion signature `poisonCloud`: spawns 1–2 lingering poison-cloud zones on the arena floor that each expire after a fixed lifetime (≤5s); standing inside a live cloud deals damage-over-time through `hurtPlayer` no more often than once per `INVULN_TIME` window (i-frames naturally gate the ticks).\n17\t11. lavablob signature `firePatch`: ignites 2–3 marked floor patches that show a ≥0.5s warning telegraph, then burn for a fixed lifetime (≤4s); contact with a burning patch damages the player via `hurtPlayer`; patches expire so the arena floor is never permanently denied.\n18\t12. bird signature `windGust`: telegraphs a lean + wind particles for ≥0.4s, then applies a horizontal push to `player.vx` for a capped duration (≤1.2s) via a `player.windPushT`/`player.windPushDir` pair read in `updatePlayer`; the push never exceeds base run speed in magnitude and the player can still move and jump against it.\n19\t13. shroom signature `sporeDaze`: releases a spore cloud telegraphed for ≥0.4s; if the player is inside it when it bursts, `player.dazeT` is set (≤1.5s) and while `dazeT>0` the player's horizontal input is dampened (reduced control), with a visible spore overlay around the player; the player still moves and jumps.\n20\t14. drone signature `shield`: projects an energy shield (`e.shieldHp`>0) that absorbs all `damageEnemy` damage to the boss until `shieldHp` reaches 0 or the shield times out (≤6s); a visible shield ring is drawn while active and the shield has a per-boss cooldown so it cannot be permanently up.\n21\t15. golem signature `crystalFall`: marks 2–4 ceiling-crystal drop spots with shadow markers on the arena floor for ≥0.5s, then drops crystals at those x positions; a crystal damages the player via `hurtPlayer` only during its fall/impact, and each crystal is removed after impact so it leaves no permanent obstacle.\n22\t16. knight signature `parry`: raises its shield for a telegraphed ≤1.2s parry window (`e.parryT`>0); while parrying, player projectiles (`projectiles`) that would hit the boss are reflected/destroyed and deal no boss damage, and a player melee swing that connects deals no damage and triggers a counter (knockback to the player via `hurtPlayer`); the raised-shield pose is visibly drawn.\n23\t17. All signature state lives on the boss enemy object or in module-level arrays declared in `platformer/js/entities.js`; `initEntities` clears every such module-level array and the cloned boss object carries no stale signature state, so a respawn fully resets all signatures (no lingering zones, no active player effects).\n24\t18. All player-side signature effect timers (`iceSlipT`, `windPushT`, `windPushDir`, `dazeT`) are fields on `player`, are initialized to 0 in `initPlayer`, and decay to 0 over time; because `initPlayer` runs on every respawn, a death clears all active player control effects.\n25\t19. Every lingering zone (dust marker, ice trail, poison cloud, fire patch, crystal-fall marker, spore cloud) has a finite `life`/timer and is removed when it expires; no signature can hold a region of the arena hazardous indefinitely.\n26\t20. Signature mechanics run inside the existing per-frame `updateEnemies` boss block (and a paired zone-update loop) at the existing fixed `dt` budget with no new external dependencies and no new timers outside `requestAnimationFrame`-driven `dt`.\n27\t\n28\t## Examples\n29\t1. slime boss at 28 HP / 56 max takes a sword hit to 27 HP (below 50%): on that frame `e._rage` becomes true AND `e._split` becomes true, and two new enemies with `_fromBoss === true` and `species === 'slime'` appear (one near `arena.x + arena.w*0.15`, one near the far side). On the next time the boss crosses 50% (it cannot — already below), no further split occurs.\n30\t2. slider boss fires its ice-dash special; `e._sliding` is true and it crosses the arena. Ice-trail zones are pushed into the module ice-trail array along the floor. The player walks onto a trail zone: `player.iceSlipT` is set to ~2.0s and idle damping uses a slippery value (~0.965) instead of `getStageModifier().fric`. After 2.0s with no trail contact, `player.iceSlipT` is 0 and idle damping is back to the stage baseline (e.g. 0.72 on a Crystal stage).\n31\t3. golem boss triggers `crystalFall`: 3 shadow markers appear on the arena floor at x = 600, 740, 880 for 0.55s (no damage during the telegraph). After the telegraph, 3 crystals fall at those x positions; a player standing at x=740 who does not move takes one `hurtPlayer` hit (HP −14, `invuln` set to 0.9) and the crystals are removed on impact, leaving the floor clear.\n32\t\n33\t## Edge Cases\n34\t1. Player is mid-i-frame (`player.invuln > 0`) when a fire patch, poison cloud, or falling crystal contacts them: no additional damage is applied that frame (the existing `hurtPlayer` guard already returns early), and the contact does not extend invuln.\n35\t2. Boss dies (HP ≤ 0) while its shield is up, while crystals are mid-fall, or while poison/fire/ice zones are live: the boss death proceeds normally, `isBossAlive()` returns false, and all lingering zones still expire on their own timers (or are cleared on the next `initEntities`) so the now-unlocked exit is reachable.\n36\t3. Player dies (falls off, spikes, or HP 0) while `player.dazeT`/`windPushT`/`iceSlipT` is active: `onPlayerDeath → respawnPlayer → initPlayer` resets those fields to 0, so the respawned player has full control with no residual daze/wind/slip.\n37\t4. slime boss is somehow already below 50% HP on its first qualifying frame (e.g. opening burst damage): `split` still fires exactly once because it is gated by the same one-shot `_split` flag, and never spawns more than the 2 split minions plus respecting the global 4-minion `spawnBossMinion` cap.\n38\t5. drone shield times out (≤6s) with `shieldHp` still > 0: the shield drops, the boss becomes damageable again, and the shield cannot reactivate until its per-boss cooldown elapses (so the boss is never permanently invulnerable).\n39\t6. Two ice-trail zones or two poison clouds overlap under the player: the player's effect timer is refreshed (set to its max, not stacked/extended beyond the cap), keeping the control effect within its ≤2.5s bound.\n40\t\n41\t## Constraints\n42\t- No new runtime dependencies; pure canvas + vanilla ES modules; must hold 60fps.\n43\t- All new module-level arrays in `platformer/js/entities.js` must be reset inside `initEntities` alongside `coins`/`enemies`/`enemyShots`.\n44\t- Player control modifications (slider ice-slip, shroom daze, bird wind) must be time-limited to ≤2.5s and visually indicated; control is dampened, never removed (the player can always still move and jump).\n45\t- A signature must never make a boss level unwinnable: no permanent arena denial, no permanent boss invulnerability, no trapping/teleporting the player; Capped at 4 live boss-spawned minions at once.\nfunction spawnBossMinion(boss) {\n  const t = boss._minionTemplate;\n  const arena = boss._minionArena;\n  if (!t || !arena) return;\n  if (enemies.filter(e => e._fromBoss && e.alive).length >= 4) return;\n\n  const air = ['fly', 'swoop', 'float', 'orbit'].includes(t.behavior);\n  const sideX = boss.x > arena.x + arena.w / 2\n    ? arena.x + arena.w * 0.15\n    : arena.x + arena.w * 0.82 - t.w;\n  const spawnY = air ? arena.y - 95 : arena.y - t.h;\n  const minion = {\n    ...t,\n    maxHp: t.hp,\n    alive: true, vy: 0, t: 0, hitFlash: 0,\n    jumpTimer: t.jumpEvery ? t.jumpEvery * 0.5 : 0,\n    x: Math.round(sideX),\n    y: Math.round(spawnY),\n    dir: boss.x > arena.x + arena.w / 2 ? 1 : -1,\n    phase: Math.random() * 6.28,\n    patrolMin: Math.round(arena.x + 4),\n    patrolMax: Math.round(arena.x + arena.w - 4 - t.w),\n    baseX: Math.round(sideX + t.w / 2),\n    baseY: Math.round(spawnY),\n    _fromBoss: true,\n  };\n  if (t.behavior === 'hop') minion.baseY = minion.y;\n  if (t.behavior === 'fly') { minion.ampX = 55; minion.ampY = 24; minion.sx = 1.1; minion.sy = 1.7; }\n  enemies.push(minion);\n  addExplosion(minion.x + t.w / 2, minion.y + t.h / 2, t.color); // spawn flash\n}\n\n// Per-species behavior AI + player contact/stomp. Returns { playerHit }.\n// Behaviors: walk (patrol), hop (bouncing patrol), fly (sine hover), swoop\n// (hover→dive at player→return), float (slow homing drift), orbit (circles an\n// anchor), charge (telegraph then dash), drop (falls when you pass beneath),\n// spider (descends a thread, climbs back), shoot (fires bolts at the player).\nexport function updateEnemies(dt, platforms, player) {\n  let playerHit = false;\n  const pcx = player.x + player.w / 2;\n  const pcy = player.y + player.h / 2;\n\n  const hurtPlayer = (dmg, fromX) => {\n    if (player.invuln > 0 || player.dead) return;\n    player.hp -= dmg;\n    player.invuln = INVULN_TIME;\n    player.hurtFlash = 0.3;\n    player.vx = (fromX >= pcx ? -1 : 1) * 260; // knock away from the source\n    player.vy = -250;\n    if (player.hp <= 0) { player.hp = 0; playerHit = true; }\n  };\n\n  for (const e of enemies) {\n    if (!e.alive) continue;\n    e.t += dt;\n    if (e.hitFlash > 0) e.hitFlash = Math.max(0, e.hitFlash - dt);\n    const bhv = e.behavior || LEGACY_BEHAVIOR[e.type] || 'walk';\n    const ecx = e.x + e.w / 2, ecy = e.y + e.h / 2;\n\n    if (bhv === 'fly') {\n      // Free-flying: pursues the player when near, otherwise hovers near home.\n      const distP = Math.hypot(pcx - ecx, pcy - ecy);\n      if (distP < 300 && distP > 1) {\n        const sp = e.chase || 85;\n        e.x += (pcx - ecx) / distP * sp * dt;\n        e.y += (pcy - ecy) / distP * sp * dt + Math.sin(e.t * 3) * 10 * dt;\n        e.dir = pcx >= ecx ? 1 : -1;\n      } else {\n        const hx = e.baseX + Math.sin(e.t * e.sx) * e.ampX;\n        const hy = e.baseY + Math.sin(e.t * e.sy + 1.3) * e.ampY;\n        e.x += (hx - e.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 2.5);\n        e.y += (hy - e.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 2.5);\n        e.dir = Math.cos(e.t * e.sx) >= 0 ? 1 : -1;\n      }\n    } else if (bhv === 'hop') {\n      // Free-roaming hopper: real gravity + landing on any platform; hops toward\n      // the player when they're near instead of staying on its home patrol.\n      e.vy += E_GRAVITY * dt;\n      const prevBottom = e.y + e.h;\n      e.y += e.vy * dt;\n      let grounded = false;\n      if (e.vy >= 0) {\n        for (const pl of platforms) {\n          if (pl._crumbleState === 2) continue;\n          if (e.x + e.w <= pl.x || e.x >= pl.x + pl.w) continue;\n          if (prevBottom <= pl.y + 6 && e.y + e.h >= pl.y) {\n            e.y = pl.y - e.h; e.vy = 0; grounded = true; break;\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      if (e.y > 600) { e.alive = false; continue; } // hopped into a pit\n      const near = Math.abs(pcx - ecx) < 320 && Math.abs(pcy - ecy) < 240;\n      if (grounded) {\n        if (near) e.dir = pcx >= ecx ? 1 : -1;\n        e.jumpTimer -= dt;\n        if (e.jumpTimer <= 0) { e.vy = -(e.jumpForce || 480); e.jumpTimer = e.jumpEvery || 1.4; }\n        e.x += e.dir * e.speed * dt * (near ? 1 : 0.65);\n        if (!near) { // patrol the home platform while idle\n          if (e.x <= e.patrolMin) { e.x = e.patrolMin; e.dir = 1; }\n          else if (e.x >= e.patrolMax) { e.x = e.patrolMax; e.dir = -1; }\n        }\n      } else {\n        e.x += e.dir * e.speed * dt; // carry momentum through the air\n      }\n    } else if (bhv === 'boss') {\n      if (e._sliding) {  // slider boss: high-speed ice dash across arena\n        e.dir = e._slideDir;\n        e.x = Math.max(e.patrolMin, Math.min(e.patrolMax, e.x + e._slideDir * e._slideV * dt));\n        e._slideT -= dt;\n        if (e._slideT <= 0 || e.x <= e.patrolMin + 4 || e.x >= e.patrolMax - 4) {\n          e._sliding = false;\n          addHitParticles(ecx, ecy, '#82ccdd', 8); // ice shatter on stop\n        }\n      } else if (e.vy !== 0 || e.y < e.baseY) { // airborne mid-leap\n        e.vy += E_GRAVITY * dt;\n        e.y += e.vy * dt;\n        e.x = Math.max(e.patrolMin, Math.min(e.patrolMax, e.x + (e._vx || 0) * dt));\n        if (e.y >= e.baseY) {\n          e.y = e.baseY; e.vy = 0; e._vx = 0;\n          addLandParticles(ecx, e.y + e.h);\n        }\n      } else {\n        if (e._cd === undefined) e._cd = 1.1;\n        e._cd = Math.max(0, e._cd - dt);\n        e.dir = pcx >= ecx ? 1 : -1;\n        e.x = Math.max(e.patrolMin, Math.min(e.patrolMax, e.x + e.dir * e.speed * dt));\n        if (e._cd <= 0) {\n          e.vy = -e.leapForce;\n          e._vx = e.dir * Math.max(120, Math.min(330, Math.abs(pcx - ecx)));\n          e._cd = e.leapEvery;\n        }\n      }\n    } else if (bhv === 'walk') {\n      e.x += e.dir * e.speed * dt;\n      if (e.x <= e.patrolMin) { e.x = e.patrolMin; e.dir = 1; }\n      else if (e.x >= e.patrolMax) { e.x = e.patrolMax; e.dir = -1; }\n    } else if (bhv === 'charge') {\n      e._cd = Math.max(0, (e._cd || 0) - dt);\n      if (e._st === 2) {            // dashing\n        e.x += e.dir * e.chargeSpeed * dt;\n        e._stT -= dt;\n        if (e.x <= e.patrolMin) { e.x = e.patrolMin; e._st = 0; e._cd = 1.3; }\n        else if (e.x >= e.patrolMax) { e.x = e.patrolMax; e._st = 0; e._cd = 1.3; }\n        else if (e._stT <= 0) { e._st = 0; e._cd = 1.3; }\n      } else if (e._st === 1) {     // telegraph windup\n        e._stT -= dt;\n        if (e._stT <= 0) { e._st = 2; e._stT = 0.9; }\n      } else {                      // patrol + look for the player\n        e.x += e.dir * e.speed * dt;\n        if (e.x <= e.patrolMin) { e.x = e.patrolMin; e.dir = 1; }\n        else if (e.x >= e.patrolMax) { e.x = e.patrolMax; e.dir = -1; }\n        if (!e._cd && Math.abs(pcy - ecy) < 70 && Math.abs(pcx - ecx) < e.chargeRange) {\n          e._st = 1; e._stT = 0.32; e.dir = pcx > ecx ? 1 : -1;\n        }\n      }\n    } else if (bhv === 'swoop') {\n      if (e._mode === 1) {          // diving at the snapshotted spot\n        const dx = e._tx - ecx, dy = e._ty - ecy;\n        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);\n        e._stT -= dt;\n        if (d < 12 || e._stT <= 0) e._mode = 2;\n        else {\n          e.x += dx / d * e.swoopSpeed * dt;\n          e.y += dy / d * e.swoopSpeed * dt;\n          e.dir = dx >= 0 ? 1 : -1;\n        }\n      } else if (e._mode === 2) {   // gliding back to the perch\n        const dx = e.baseX - ecx, dy = e.baseY - ecy;\n        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);\n        if (d < 8) { e._mode = 0; e._cd = 1.0; }\n        else {\n          e.x += dx / d * e.swoopSpeed * 0.6 * dt;\n          e.y += dy / d * e.swoopSpeed * 0.6 * dt;\n          e.dir = dx >= 0 ? 1 : -1;\n        }\n      } else {                      // hovering at the perch\n        e.x = e.baseX + Math.sin(e.t * 1.2) * 16 - e.w / 2;\n        e.y = e.baseY + Math.sin(e.t * 1.9) * 9;\n        e._cd = Math.max(0, (e._cd || 0) - dt);\n        if (!e._cd && Math.hypot(pcx - ecx, pcy - ecy) < e.swoopRange) {\n          e._mode = 1; e._tx = pcx; e._ty = pcy; e._stT = 1.0;\n        }\n      }\n    } else if (bhv === 'float') {\n      // Slow homing drift while the player is near; otherwise drift home.\n      const near = Math.hypot(pcx - ecx, pcy - ecy) < 340;\n      const tx = near ? pcx : e.baseX, ty = near ? pcy : e.baseY;\n      const dx = tx - ecx, dy = ty - ecy;\n      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;\n      const sp = Math.min(e.floatSpeed, d * 2);\n      e.x += dx / d * sp * dt;\n      e.y += dy / d * sp * dt + Math.sin(e.t * 2.2) * 12 * dt;\n      e.dir = dx >= 0 ? 1 : -1;\n    } else if (bhv === 'orbit') {\n      // The anchor itself stalks the player slowly, so orbiters roam too.\n      const dax = pcx - e.baseX, day = pcy - e.baseY;\n      const da = Math.hypot(dax, day);\n      if (da > 1 && da < 320) {\n        e.baseX += dax / da * 28 * dt;\n        e.baseY += day / da * 28 * dt;\n      }\n      const a = e.t * e.orbitSpd + (e.phase || 0);\n      e.x = e.baseX + Math.cos(a) * e.orbitR - e.w / 2;\n      e.y = e.baseY + Math.sin(a) * e.orbitR * 0.7 - e.h / 2;\n      e.dir = -Math.sin(a) >= 0 ? 1 : -1;\n    } else if (bhv === 'drop') {\n      if (e._mode === 1) {          // falling\n        e.vy += 2300 * dt;\n        e.y += e.vy * dt;\n        for (const pl of platforms) {\n          if (pl._crumbleState === 2) continue;\n          if (e.x + e.w > pl.x && e.x < pl.x + pl.w &&\n              e.y + e.h >= pl.y && e.y + e.h <= pl.y + pl.h + 18) {\n            e.alive = false; // shatters on impact\n            addHitParticles(ecx, e.y + e.h, e.color, 10);\n            break;\n          }\n        }\n        if (e.y > 600) e.alive = false;\n      } else {                      // hanging, waiting for the player below\n        e.y = e.baseY + Math.sin(e.t * 1.4) * 2;\n        if (Math.abs(pcx - ecx) < 30 && pcy > e.y + e.h) { e._mode = 1; e.vy = 60; }\n      }\n    } else if (bhv === 'spider') {\n      if (e._mode === 1) {          // dropping down the thread\n        e.y += e.dropSpeed * dt;\n        if (e.y >= e.dropY) { e.y = e.dropY; e._mode = 2; e._stT = 0.65; }\n      } else if (e._mode === 2) {   // lingering low\n        e._stT -= dt;\n        if (e._stT <= 0) e._mode = 3;\n      } else if (e._mode === 3) {   // climbing back up\n        e.y -= 120 * dt;\n        if (e.y <= e.anchorY) { e.y = e.anchorY; e._mode = 0; e._cd = 0.8; }\n      } else {                      // waiting at the anchor\n        e.y = e.anchorY + Math.sin(e.t * 1.6) * 4;\n        e._cd = Math.max(0, (e._cd || 0) - dt);\n        if (!e._cd && Math.abs(pcx - ecx) < 64 && pcy > e.y) e._mode = 1;\n      }\n    } else if (bhv === 'shoot') {\n      e.dir = pcx >= ecx ? 1 : -1;  // track the player\n      if (e._cd === undefined) e._cd = e.fireEvery * 0.5;\n      e._cd = Math.max(0, e._cd - dt);\n      if (e._cd <= 0 && Math.abs(pcx - ecx) < e.range && Math.abs(pcy - ecy) < 90) {\n        enemyShots.push({\n          x: ecx + e.dir * (e.w / 2 + 6), y: e.y + 6,\n          vx: e.dir * 330, dmg: e.shotDmg, life: 2.2,\n        });\n        e._cd = e.fireEvery;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Boss special attack system: per-species cooldown + rage at 50% HP\n    if (e.boss) {\n      if (!e._rage && e.hp > 0 && e.hp <= e.maxHp * 0.5) {\n        e._rage = true;\n        e.speed = Math.round((e.speed || 60) * 1.4);\n        if (e.leapEvery) e.leapEvery = Math.max(0.9, e.leapEvery * 0.7);\n        e.swoopSpeed = Math.round((e.swoopSpeed || 300) * 1.3);\n        addExplosion(ecx, ecy, e.color);\n        addExplosion(ecx, ecy - 24, '#ff4500');\n      }\n      if (e._atkFlash > 0) e._atkFlash -= dt;\n      e._specialCD -= dt;\n      if (e._specialCD <= 0) {\n        triggerBossSpecial(e, pcx, pcy);\n        e._specialCD = e._baseCD * (e._rage ? 0.65 : 1.0);\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (player.dead) continue;\n    if (rectsOverlap(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h, e.x, e.y, e.w, e.h)) {\n      const prevBottom = player._prevY + player.h;\n      const stomping = player.vy > 0 && prevBottom <= e.y + 12;\n      if (stomping) {\n        damageEnemy(e, STOMP_DAMAGE, player.x < e.x ? 1 : -1, 240);\n        player.vy = -STOMP_BOUNCE;\n        player.y = e.y - player.h;\n        player._prevY = player.y;\n        player.jumpsLeft = Math.max(player.jumpsLeft, 1); // regain a hop after a stomp\n      } else {\n        // If the player is mid-attack and facing this enemy, the weapon connects\n        // and the contact deals no damage — so you can fight foes up close.\n        const eCx = e.x + e.w / 2;\n        const facingEnemy = player.facing > 0 ? eCx >= player.x : eCx <= player.x + player.w;\n        const guarding = (player.attackCD > 0 || player.swingT > 0) && facingEnemy;\n        if (!guarding) hurtPlayer(e.dmg || CONTACT_DAMAGE[e.type] || 8, eCx);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Enemy shots: turret bolts (straight) + boss specials (may arc with vy/grav).\n  for (let i = enemyShots.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {\n    const s = enemyShots[i];\n    s.x += s.vx * dt;\n    s.y += (s.vy || 0) * dt;\n    s.vy = (s.vy || 0) + (s.grav || 0) * dt;\n    s.life -= dt;\n    let dead = s.life <= 0;\n    if (!dead) {\n      for (const pl of platforms) {\n        if (pl._crumbleState === 2) continue;\n        if (pl.type === 'ground') {\n          if (s.x > pl.x && s.x < pl.x + pl.w && s.y > pl.y) { dead = true; break; }\n        } else if (s.x > pl.x && s.x < pl.x + pl.w && s.y > pl.y && s.y < pl.y + pl.h) {\n          dead = true; break;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    if (!dead && !player.dead) {\n      // Boss specials use circular hit detection scaled to the projectile radius;\n      // regular turret bolts keep the original simple box check.\n      const sr = s.r || 3;\n      const pCx = player.x + player.w / 2, pCy = player.y + player.h / 2;\n      const hit = s.boss\n        ? Math.hypot(s.x - pCx, s.y - pCy) < sr + player.w * 0.35\n        : s.x > player.x && s.x < player.x + player.w && s.y > player.y && s.y < player.y + player.h;\n      if (hit) {\n        hurtPlayer(s.dmg, s.x - s.vx * 0.1);\n        addHitParticles(s.x, s.y, s.color || '#7fdfff', s.boss ? 8 : 5);\n        dead = true;\n      }\n    }\n    if (dead) enemyShots.splice(i, 1);\n  }\n\n  return { playerHit };\n}\n\n// ─── ENEMY / PROJECTILE RENDERING ──────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport function drawProjectiles(ctx, camX, W) {\n  for (const pr of projectiles) {\n    if (pr.x < camX - 20 || pr.x > camX + W + 20) continue;\n    // trail\n    ctx.strokeStyle = pr.color;\n    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;\n    ctx.lineWidth = pr.r;\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.moveTo(pr.x, pr.y);\n    ctx.lineTo(pr.x - pr.vx * 0.02, pr.y - pr.vy * 0.02);\n    ctx.stroke();\n    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;\n    // glow + core\n    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(pr.x, pr.y, 0, pr.x, pr.y, pr.r * 3);\n    g.addColorStop(0, pr.color);\n    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');\n    ctx.fillStyle = g;\n    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(pr.x, pr.y, pr.r * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();\n    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';\n    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(pr.x, pr.y, pr.r * 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();\n  }\n}\n\nexport function drawEnemies(ctx, camX, W, t) {\n  for (const e of enemies) {\n    if (!e.alive) continue;\n    if (e.x + e.w < camX - 40 || e.x > camX + W + 80) continue;\n\n    const cx = e.x + e.w / 2;\n    ctx.save();\n    ctx.translate(cx, e.y);\n\n    const sd = SPECIES_DRAW[e.species];\n    if (sd) {\n      if (e.boss) { // menacing aura — expands and turns orange when enraged\n        const raging = !!e._rage;\n        const ar = Math.max(e.w, e.h) * (raging ? 0.95 : 0.78);\n        const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, e.h / 2, ar * 0.3, 0, e.h / 2, ar);\n        g.addColorStop(0, raging ? 'rgba(255,90,0,0.22)' : 'rgba(255,40,40,0.16)');\n        g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,40,0,0)');\n        ctx.fillStyle = g;\n        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, e.h / 2, ar, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();\n        if (raging) { // pulsing ring\n          const pls = 0.5 + Math.sin(e.t * 8) * 0.5;\n          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,110,0,${pls * 0.65})`;\n          ctx.lineWidth = 3.5;\n          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, e.h / 2, ar * 0.82, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();\n          ctx.lineWidth = 1;\n        }\n      }\n      ctx.save();\n      if (e.dir < 0) ctx.scale(-1, 1); // species art faces +x; flip to face travel\n      if (e.bossScale > 1) {\n        // draw the species at its native proportions, scaled up to boss size\n        ctx.scale(e.bossScale, e.bossScale);\n        sd(ctx, { ...e, w: e.w / e.bossScale, h: e.h / e.bossScale }, t);\n      } else {\n        sd(ctx, e, t);\n      }\n      ctx.restore();\n    } else if (e.type === 'flyer') drawFlyer(ctx, e);\n    else if (e.type === 'jumper') drawJumper(ctx, e);\n    else if (e.type === 'brute') drawBrute(ctx, e);\n    else drawWalker(ctx, e, t);\n\n    // hit flash\n    if (e.hitFlash > 0) {\n      ctx.globalAlpha = e.hitFlash / 0.13 * 0.8;\n      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';\n      ctx.fillRect(-e.w / 2, 0, e.w, e.h);\n      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;\n    }\n    // special attack charge flash (yellow burst when a boss special fires)\n    if (e._atkFlash > 0) {\n      ctx.globalAlpha = (e._atkFlash / 0.45) * 0.72;\n      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe066';\n      ctx.fillRect(-e.w / 2, 0, e.w, e.h);\n      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;\n    }\n    ctx.restore();\n\n    if (e.boss) {\n      // chunky boss HP bar — turns orange in rage, shows 50% rage threshold marker\n      const bw = e.w + 14;\n      const bx = e.x + e.w / 2 - bw / 2;\n      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';\n      ctx.fillRect(bx - 2, e.y - 20, bw + 4, 12);\n      ctx.fillStyle = e._rage ? '#ff6b35' : '#e74c3c';\n      ctx.fillRect(bx, e.y - 18, bw * Math.max(0, e.hp / e.maxHp), 8);\n      // rage threshold marker at 50%\n      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,50,0.85)';\n      ctx.fillRect(bx + bw * 0.5 - 1, e.y - 20, 2, 12);\n      if (e._rage) {\n        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8c42';\n        ctx.font = 'bold 9px monospace';\n        ctx.textAlign = 'center';\n        ctx.fillText('ENRAGED', e.x + e.w / 2, e.y - 24);\n        ctx.textAlign = 'left';\n      }\n    } else if (e.maxHp > 1) {\n      // HP pips above tougher enemies\n      const pw = e.w / e.maxHp;\n      for (let i = 0; i < e.maxHp; i++) {\n        ctx.fillStyle = i < e.hp ? '#e74c3c' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.18)';\n        ctx.fillRect(e.x + i * pw + 1, e.y - 9, pw - 2, 4);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Enemy shots: boss specials (glowing orbs) and turret bolts\n  for (const s of enemyShots) {\n    if (s.x < camX - 30 || s.x > camX + W + 30) continue;\n    if (s.boss) {\n      const r = s.r || 7;\n      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(s.x, s.y, 0, s.x, s.y, r * 1.9);\n      g.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');\n      g.addColorStop(0.3, s.color || '#ff4444');\n      g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');\n      ctx.fillStyle = g;\n      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, r * 1.9, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();\n      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';\n      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, r * 0.32, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();\n    } else {\n      // turret bolt\n      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(s.x, s.y, 0, s.x, s.y, 9);\n      g.addColorStop(0, '#bff4ff');\n      g.addColorStop(0.4, '#46d5ff');\n      g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(70,213,255,0)');\n      ctx.fillStyle = g;\n      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();\n      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';\n      ctx.fillRect(s.x - (s.vx > 0 ? 6 : 0), s.y - 1.5, 6, 3);\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nfunction eyes(ctx, w, y, dir, angry) {\n  const ex = w * 0.18;\n  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';\n  ctx.beginPath();\n  ctx.arc(-ex, y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n  ctx.arc(ex, y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n  ctx.fill();\n  ctx.fillStyle = '#111';\n  ctx.beginPath();\n  ctx.arc(-ex + dir * 1.5, y, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n  ctx.arc(ex + dir * 1.5, y, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n  ctx.fill();\n  if (angry) {\n    ctx.strokeStyle = '#111';\n    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.moveTo(-ex - 4, y - 6); ctx.lineTo(-ex + 3, y - 3);\n    ctx.moveTo(ex + 4, y - 6); ctx.lineTo(ex - 3, y - 3);\n    ctx.stroke();\n  }\n}\n\nfunction drawWalker(ctx, e, t) {\n  const w = e.w, h = e.h;\n  // shuffling feet\n  const sh = Math.sin((t || 0) * 9 + e.x * 0.1) * 2;\n  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';\n  ctx.fillRect(-w * 0.32, h - 4 + sh, w * 0.26, 5);\n  ctx.fillRect(w * 0.06, h - 4 - sh, w * 0.26, 5);\n  // body\n  ctx.fillStyle = e.color;\n  roundRectE(ctx, -w / 2, 2, w, h - 4, 7);\n  ctx.fill();\n  // darker belly\n  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.18)';\n  roundRectE(ctx, -w / 2 + 3, h * 0.5, w - 6, h * 0.4, 5);\n  ctx.fill();\n  eyes(ctx, w, h * 0.36, e.dir, true);\n  // frown\n  ctx.strokeStyle = '#111'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;\n  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, h * 0.66, 4, Math.PI + 0.3, -0.3); ctx.stroke();\n}\n\nfunction drawBrute(ctx, e) {\n  const w = e.w, h = e.h;\n  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';\n  ctx.fillRect(-w * 0.34, h - 5, w * 0.3, 6);\n  ctx.fillRect(w * 0.04, h - 5, w * 0.3, 6);\n  // armored body\n  ctx.fillStyle = e.color;\n  roundRectE(ctx, -w / 2, 0, w, h - 3, 6);\n  ctx.fill();\n  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)'; ctx.lineWidth = 3;\n  roundRectE(ctx, -w / 2 + 1.5, 1.5, w - 3, h - 6, 6); ctx.stroke();\n  // helmet band\n  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';\n  ctx.fillRect(-w / 2, h * 0.22, w, 5);\n  eyes(ctx, w, h * 0.42, e.dir, true);\n}\n\nfunction drawJumper(ctx, e) {\n  const w = e.w, h = e.h;\n  // spring coil\n  ctx.strokeStyle = '#888'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;\n  ctx.beginPath();\n  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) ctx.arc(0, h - 4 - i * 4, w * 0.28, 0, Math.PI);\n  ctx.stroke();\n  ctx.fillStyle = e.color;\n  ctx.beginPath();\n  ctx.arc(0, h * 0.42, w * 0.46, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n  ctx.fill();\n  eyes(ctx, w, h * 0.36, e.dir, false);\n}\n\nfunction drawFlyer(ctx, e) {\n  const w = e.w, h = e.h;\n  const flap = Math.sin(e.t * 14) * 0.5;\n  // wings\n  ctx.fillStyle = e.color;\n  ctx.save(); -lerp(40, 72, e) : lerp(20, 42, e);\n270\t    connect(b, gap, b.y + dy, w, 'normal', 54, 1);\n271\t    up = !up;\n272\t  }\n273\t}\n274\t\n275\t// Long leaps — a couple of near-max double-jump gaps with a fat coin trail.\n276\tfunction segLongLeap(b, e) {\n277\t  const n = 2 + Math.floor(b.rng() * 2);\n278\t  const gap = lerp(185, 248, e);\n279\t  const w = lerp(140, 92, e);\n280\t  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n281\t    connect(b, gap + b.rng() * 8, b.y + (b.rng() - 0.5) * 56, w, 'normal', 82, 4);\n282\t  }\n283\t}\n284\t\n285\t// Descent shaft — controlled drop down a stack of ledges.\n286\tfunction segDescentDrop(b, e) {\n287\t  const n = 2 + Math.floor(b.rng() * 2);\n288\t  const w = lerp(112, 72, e);\n289\t  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n290\t    connect(b, lerp(58, 92, e), b.y + lerp(70, 120, e), w, 'normal', 22, 1);\n291\t  }\n292\t}\n293\t\n294\t// Ground run studded with spike clusters you must hop over.\n295\tfunction segSpikePath(b, e) {\n296\t  connect(b, lerp(42, 72, e), FLOOR, 92, 'normal', 30, 1); // step down to ground level\n297\t  const runLen = lerp(520, 820, e);\n298\t  const gx = b.x + 8;\n299\t  b.plats.push(mkGround(gx, runLen));\n300\t  const clusters = 2 + Math.floor(e * 3 + b.rng() * 2);\n301\t  for (let k = 0; k < clusters; k++) {\n302\t    const cxk = gx + runLen * (k + 1) / (clusters + 1) - 20;\n303\t    const cnt = 1 + Math.floor(e * 2 + b.rng() * 2);\n304\t    addSpikes(b, cxk, GROUND_Y, cnt, 'up', 20);\n305\t    arcCoins(b.coins, cxk - 22, GROUND_Y - 20, cxk + cnt * 20 + 22, GROUND_Y - 20, 3, b.rng, 62);\n306\t  }\n307\t  b.x = gx + runLen; b.y = GROUND_Y;\n308\t}\n309\t\n310\t// Horizontal moving platform ferrying you across a void. Timing puzzle.\n311\tfunction segMovingBridge(b, e) {\n312\t  connect(b, lerp(80, 110, e), b.y + (b.rng() - 0.5) * 28, lerp(120, 90, e), 'normal', 40, 1);\n313\t  const range = lerp(140, 240, e);\n314\t  const mw = lerp(96, 64, e);\n315\t  const my = clamp(b.y + (b.rng() - 0.5) * 18, TOP + 80, FLOOR);\n316\t  const baseX = b.x + lerp(40, 70, e);\n317\t  const mp = mkP(baseX, my, mw, 'move');\n318\t  mp.move = { axis: 'x', baseX, baseY: my, max: baseX + range, speed: lerp(1.4, 2.4, e), phase: b.rng() * 6.28 };\n319\t  b.plats.push(mp);\n320\t  const landX = baseX + range + lerp(150, 230, e);\n321\t  const ly = clamp(my + (b.rng() - 0.5) * 28, TOP + 80, FLOOR);\n322\t  const lp = mkP(landX, ly, lerp(130, 92, e), 'normal');\n323\t  b.plats.push(lp);\n324\t  arcCoins(b.coins, baseX, my, landX, ly, 4, b.rng, 50);\n325\t  nCoins(b.coins, lp, 2, b.rng);\n326\t  b.x = lp.x + lp.w; b.y = ly;\n327\t}\n328\t\n329\t// Vertical elevator lifting you up a shaft to a higher ledge.\n330\tfunction segElevator(b, e) {\n331\t  connect(b, lerp(80, 110, e), Math.min(FLOOR, b.y + lerp(0, 40, e)), lerp(120, 90, e), 'normal', 40, 1);\n332\t  const bottom = b.y;\n333\t  const rise = lerp(120, 205, e);\n334\t  const top = clamp(bottom - rise, TOP + 40, FLOOR);\n335\t  const mw = lerp(102, 70, e);\n336\t  const baseX = b.x + lerp(50, 80, e);\n337\t  const mp = mkP(baseX, bottom, mw, 'move');\n338\t  mp.move = { axis: 'y', baseX, baseY: bottom, max: top, speed: lerp(1.0, 1.7, e), phase: 0 };\n339\t  b.plats.push(mp);\n340\t  const lp = mkP(baseX + mw + lerp(40, 70, e), top, lerp(122, 86, e), 'normal');\n341\t  b.plats.push(lp);\n342\t  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {\n343\t    b.coins.push(mkCoin(baseX + mw / 2 - 8, bottom - (i + 1) * (rise / 5), b.rng() * 6.28));\n344\t  }\n345\t  nCoins(b.coins, lp, 2, b.rng);\n346\t  b.x = lp.x + lp.w; b.y = top;\n347\t}\n348\t\n349\t// Low corridor with ceiling spikes — a single jump clears each gap, but a\n350\t// double jump skewers you. Punishes panic-jumping.\n351\tfunction segGauntlet(b, e) {\n352\t  const n = 3 + Math.floor(b.rng() * 2);\n353\t  const w = lerp(112, 78, e);\n354\t  const gap = lerp(80, 120, e);\n355\t  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n356\t    const pl = connect(b, gap, clamp(b.y + (b.rng() - 0.5) * 18, FLOOR - 70, FLOOR), w, 'normal', 26, 1);\n357\t    const ceilY = pl.y - lerp(178, 150, e); // high enough that a single jump clears, a double doesn't\n358\t    addSpikes(b, pl.x + 6, ceilY, Math.max(2, Math.floor(pl.w / 20) - 1), 'down', 18);\n359\t  }\n360\t}\n361\t\n362\t// Crumbling platforms that fall away seconds after you touch them — keep moving.\n363\tfunction segCrumbleRun(b, e) {\n364\t  const n = 3 + Math.floor(b.rng() * 3);\n365\t  const w = lerp(98, 66, e);\n366\t  const gap = lerp(95, 148, e);\n367\t  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n368\t    connect(b, gap, b.y + (b.rng() - 0.5) * 28, w, 'crumble', 50, 1);\n369\t  }\n370\t  connect(b, gap, b.y, lerp(122, 92, e), 'normal', 40, 2); // solid landing to recover\n371\t}\n372\t\n373\t// One big leap over an open spike pit — miss and you're impaled.\n374\tfunction segSpikeLeap(b, e) {\n375\t  connect(b, lerp(80, 110, e), b.y, lerp(110, 82, e), 'normal', 28, 1);\n376\t  const gap = lerp(190, 250, e);\n377\t  const pitX = b.x + 30;\n378\t  const pitW = gap - 30;\n379\t  const sCount = Math.max(2, Math.floor(pitW / 22));\n380\t  addSpikes(b, pitX, GROUND_Y, sCount, 'up', 22);\n381\t  connect(b, gap, b.y + (b.rng() - 0.5) * 28, lerp(122, 92, e), 'normal', 86, 4);\n382\t}\n383\t\n384\t// Reward vault — a wide safe platform with a patterned coin payout. Adds\n385\t// authored \"set piece\" flavor and a moment to breathe.\n386\tfunction segCoinVault(b, e) {\n387\t  const pl = connect(b, lerp(70, 100, e), clamp(b.y + (b.rng() - 0.5) * 28, TOP + 130, FLOOR), lerp(210, 160, e), 'normal', 40, 0);\n388\t  arcCoins(b.coins, pl.x + 12, pl.y - 8, pl.x + pl.w - 12, pl.y - 8, 6, b.rng, 72);\n389\t  nCoins(b.coins, pl, 4, b.rng);\n390\t}\n391\t\n392\t// Final approach — a generous platform that hosts the exit door.\n393\tfunction segFinish(b) {\n394\t  const pl = connect(b, 105, clamp(b.y, TOP + 130, FLOOR), 210, 'normal', 45, 0);\n395\t  nCoins(b.coins, pl, 5, b.rng);\n396\t}\n397\t\n398\t// ─── SEGMENT TABLE & SELECTION ───────────────────────────────────────────────\n399\t// tier: 0 easy, 1 medium, 2 hard. gate: minimum global progress before a\n400\t// mechanic is allowed to appear (so stage 1 doesn't open with crumble + spikes).\n401\tconst SEGMENTS = [\n402\t  { id: 'gap', fn: segGapRun, tier: 0, gate: 0 },\n403\t  { id: 'stairsUp', fn: segStairsUp, tier: 0, gate: 0 },\n404\t  { id: 'stairsDown', fn: segStairsDown, tier: 0, gate: 0 },\n405\t  { id: 'coinVault', fn: segCoinVault, tier: 0, gate: 0 },\n406\t  { id: 'pillars', fn: segPillars, tier: 1, gate: 0 },\n407\t  { id: 'zigzag', fn: segZigzag, tier: 1, gate: 0 },\n408\t  { id: 'longLeap', fn: segLongLeap, tier: 1, gate: 0 },\n409\t  { id: 'descent', fn: segDescentDrop, tier: 1, gate: 0 },\n410\t  { id: 'spikePath', fn: segSpikePath, tier: 1, gate: 0.03 },\n411\t  { id: 'movingBridge', fn: segMovingBridge, tier: 2, gate: 0.06 },\n412\t  { id: 'elevator', fn: segElevator, tier: 2, gate: 0.06 },\n413\t  { id: 'gauntlet', fn: segGauntlet, tier: 2, gate: 0.10 },\n414\t  { id: 'crumble', fn: segCrumbleRun, tier: 2, gate: 0.16 },\n415\t  { id: 'spikeLeap', fn: segSpikeLeap, tier: 2, gate: 0.20 },\n416\t];\n417\t\n418\tfunction pickSegment(b, e, last, prof) {\n419\t  const allow = prof && prof.pool;\n420\t  const ok = s => b.p >= s.gate && s.fn !== last && (!allow || allow.includes(s.id));\n421\t  const desired = e < 0.34 ? 0 : e < 0.66 ? 1 : 2;\n422\t  let pool = SEGMENTS.filter(s => ok(s) && s.tier <= desired && s.tier >= desired - 1);\n423\t  if (!pool.length) pool = SEGMENTS.filter(s => ok(s) && s.tier <= desired);\n424\t  if (!pool.length) pool = SEGMENTS.filter(s => b.p >= s.gate && (!allow || allow.includes(s.id)));\n425\t  if (!pool.length) pool = SEGMENTS.filter(s => b.p >= s.gate);\n426\t  if (!pool.length) pool = [SEGMENTS[0]];\n427\t  return pool[Math.floor(b.rng() * pool.length)];\n428\t}\n429\t\n430\t// ─── LEVEL ASSEMBLY ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n431\t// Builds the level as an intentional arc: warm-up → escalating challenges\n432\t// (paced with breathers) → a hard climax → the exit approach. Difficulty ramps\n433\t// both across the 500 levels (global `p`) and within each level (local `e`).\n434\tfunction buildLevel(rng, p, stageIdx) {\n435\t  const prof = getProfile(stageIdx);\n436\t  const b = { rng, p, x: 220, y: FLOOR, plats: [], coins: [], hazards: [], low: !!prof.low };\n437\t\n438\t  // Gentle on-ramp for the opening levels: the first ~15 levels (the start of\n439\t  // Meadow) begin short and easy, then ramp up to the full length/difficulty\n440\t  // curve. `introT` is 0 on level 1 and reaches 1 by ~level 16.\n441\t  const idx = Math.round(p * 499);            // global level index 0..499\n442\t  const introT = clamp(idx / 15, 0, 1);\n443\t  const baseW = lerp(5500, 24000, p);         // full-curve length for this progress\n444\t  const targetW = lerp(1800, baseW, introT);  // much shorter while easing in\n445\t\n446\t  // Boss levels: every 10th level (10/20/30/40/50 of each stage) is a short\n447\t  // approach into a very large arena platform holding the stage boss. The exit\n448\t  // stays locked until the boss is defeated (gated in entities.js/main.js).\n449\t  if (idx % 10 === 9) {\n450\t    segRest(b, 0.15);\n451\t    const seg = pickSegment(b, 0.3, null, prof);\n452\t    seg.fn(b, 0.3);\n453\t    segRest(b, 0.2);\n454\t    const arena = mkP(b.x + 100, clamp(b.y + 40, TOP + 150, FLOOR), 1150, 'normal');\n455\t    b.plats.push(arena);\n456\t    arcCoins(b.coins, b.x, b.y, arena.x + 90, arena.y, 3, rng, 55);\n457\t    b.x = arena.x + arena.w; b.y = arena.y;\n458\t    b.arena = arena;\n459\t    segFinish(b);\n460\t    return b;\n461\t  }\n462\t\n463\t  segRest(b, 0.08); // gentle landing right after the start pad\n464\t\n465\t  let last = null;\n466\t  let sinceRest = 0;\n467\t  let guard = 0;\n468\t  while (b.x < targetW - 900 && guard++ < 600) {\n469\t    const f = clamp(b.x / targetW, 0, 1);\n470\t    const localE = lerp(0.12, 1.0, f);\n471\t    let e = clamp(p * 0.45 + localE * 0.55, 0, 1);\n472\t    e *= 0.5 + 0.5 * introT; // hold the opening levels down in the easy tier\n473\t\n474\t    // Insert a breather every few segments so the level has rhythm.\n475\t    if (sinceRest >= 2 + Math.floor(rng() * 2)) {\n476\t      segRest(b, e); sinceRest = 0; continue;\n477\t    }\n478\t\n479\t    const seg = pickSegment(b, e, last, prof);\n480\t    seg.fn(b, e);\n481\t    last = seg.fn;\n482\t    sinceRest++;\n483\t  }\n484\t\n485\t  // Climax: a deliberately hard set piece right before the finish — but eased\n486\t  // way down during the on-ramp, and skipped entirely on the first few levels\n487\t  // so they stay short and end gently instead of on a wall.\n488\t  if (introT >= 0.2) {\n489\t    const climaxE = clamp((p * 0.5 + 0.88) * (0.35 + 0.65 * introT), 0, 1);\n490\t    const climax = pickSegment(b, climaxE, last, prof);\n491\t    climax.fn(b, climaxE);\n492\t  }\n493\t\n494\t  segFinish(b);\n495\t  return b;\n496\t}\n497\t\n498\t// ─── ENEMY PLACEMENT ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n499\t// Scatters enemies across the finished geometry. Ground-bound foes patrol the\n500\t// platform they spawn on; flyers hover in wide gaps. Count, HP and type variety\n501\t// all scale with global progress `p`, and the start pad + exit platform stay\n502\t// clear so spawns and finishes are safe.\n503\tfunction makeGroundFoe(pl, rng, p, roster) {\n504\t  if (!roster.ground.length) return null;\n505\t  const base = SPECIES[pickSpecies(roster.ground, rng)](p);\n506\t  if (pl.w < base.w + 24) return null; // platform too small to patrol\n507\t  const min = pl.x + 4;\n508\t  const max = pl.x + pl.w - 4 - base.w;\n509\t  const e = {\n510\t    ...base, x: Math.round(lerp(min, max, rng())), y: Math.round(pl.y - base.h),\n511\t    dir: rng() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1, phase: rng() * 6.28,\n512\t    patrolMin: Math.round(min), patrolMax: Math.round(max),\n513\t  };\n514\t  if (base.behavior === 'hop') e.baseY = e.y;\n515\t  if (base.behavior === 'shoot') { e.patrolMin = e.patrolMax = e.x; } // emplaced gun\n516\t  return e;\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\tfunction placeEnemies(platforms, rng, p, exitPlat, stageIdx) {\n520\t  const prof = getProfile(stageIdx);\n521\t  const roster = STAGE_ROSTER[((stageIdx % 10) + 10) % 10];\n522\t  const enemies = [];\n523\t  if (p < 0.012) return enemies; // very first level stays enemy-free\n524\t  const density = lerp(0.12, 0.6, p);\n525\t  const CAP = 46;\n526\t  const exitCx = exitPlat.x + exitPlat.w / 2;\n527\t\n528\t  // Builders for air dwellers (hover over gaps) and hang species (anchored\n529\t  // above a walkway: falling icicles, thread spiders).\n530\t  const mkAir = (sp, midX, baseY, gap) => {\n531\t    const base = SPECIES[sp](p);\n532\t    const e = {\n533\t      ...base, x: Math.round(midX), y: Math.round(baseY),\n534\t      dir: 1, phase: rng() * 6.28, patrolMin: 0, patrolMax: 0,\n535\t      baseX: Math.round(midX), baseY: Math.round(baseY),\n536\t    };\n537\t    if (base.behavior === 'fly') {\n538\t      e.ampX = Math.min(gap * 0.3, 120); e.ampY = lerp(15, 42, p);\n539\t      e.sx = 0.8 + rng() * 0.9; e.sy = 1.4 + rng() * 1.1;\n540\t    }\n541\t    return e;\n542\t  };\n543\t  const mkHang = (sp, cx, platTop) => {\n544\t    const base = SPECIES[sp](p);\n545\t    const anchorY = Math.round(clamp(platTop - lerp(160, 215, rng()), TOP + 8, platTop - 120));\n546\t    return {\n547\t      ...base, x: Math.round(cx - base.w / 2), y: anchorY,\n548\t      dir: 1, phase: rng() * 6.28, patrolMin: 0, patrolMax: 0,\n549\t      baseX: Math.round(cx), baseY: anchorY, anchorY,\n550\t      dropY: Math.round(platTop - base.h - 6),\n551\t    };\n552\t  };\n553\t\n554\t  // Ground patrollers on solid platforms / ground runs.\n555\t  for (const pl of platforms) {\n556\t    if (enemies.length >= CAP || !roster.ground.length) break;\n557\t    if (pl === exitPlat) continue;\n558\t    if (pl.type === 'move' || pl.type === 'crumble') continue; // unstable footing\n559\t    if (pl.type !== 'ground' && pl.type !== 'normal') continue;\n560\t\n561\t    // A wide continuous floor (grounded stages) gets several foes spaced along it\n562\t    // rather than a single one, so terrain levels feel populated.\n563\t    if (pl.type === 'ground' && pl.w > 360) {\n564\t      const slots = Math.min(8, Math.floor(pl.w / 360));\n565\t      for (let s = 0; s < slots && enemies.length < CAP; s++) {\n566\t        const cx = pl.x + pl.w * (s + 0.5) / slots;\n567\t        if (cx < 340) continue;                          // keep the opening safe\n568\t        if (Math.abs(cx - exitCx) < 200) continue;        // keep the finish safe\n569\t        if (rng() >= density) continue;\n570\t        const e = makeGroundFoe({ x: Math.round(cx - 60), y: pl.y, w: 120 }, rng, p, roster);\n571\t        if (e) enemies.push(e);\n572\t      }\n573\t      continue;\n574\t    }\n575\t\n576\t    if (pl.x < 320) continue;            // keep the opening safe\n577\t    if (pl.w < 50) continue;\n578\t    if (rng() >= density) continue;\n579\t    const e = makeGroundFoe(pl, rng, p, roster);\n580\t    if (e) enemies.push(e);\n581\t  }\n582\t\n583\t  // Hang species anchored above walkways (drop on / descend at the player).\n584\t  if (roster.hang.length) {\n585\t    for (const pl of platforms) {\n586\t      if (enemies.length >= CAP) break;\n587\t      if (pl === exitPlat) continue;\n588\t      if (pl.type === 'ground' && pl.w > 480) {\n589\t        const slots = Math.min(6, Math.floor(pl.w / 480));\n590\t        for (let s = 0; s < slots && enemies.length < CAP; s++) {\n591\t          const cx = pl.x + pl.w * (s + 0.5) / slots;\n592\t          if (cx < 380 || Math.abs(cx - exitCx) < 220) continue;\n593\t          if (rng() >= density * 0.55) continue;\n594\t          enemies.push(mkHang(pickSpecies(roster.hang, rng), cx, pl.y));\n595\t        }\n596\t      } else if (pl.type === 'normal' && pl.w >= 70 && pl.x > 360) {\n597\t        if (rng() >= density * 0.5) continue;\n598\t        const cx = pl.x + pl.w * (0.25 + rng() * 0.5);\n599\t        if (Math.abs(cx - exitCx) < 220) continue;\n600\t        enemies.push(mkHang(pickSpecies(roster.hang, rng), cx, pl.y));\n601\t      }\n602\t    }\n603\t  }\n604\t\n605\t  // Air dwellers over gaps — frequency and gap tolerance scale with the stage's\n606\t  // flyerFreq (cave bats and sky birds are common; ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Every 10th level fields the stage's signature species scaled up ×3 on a huge\n// arena. Ground bosses use the 'boss' leap-chase behavior; sky/space bosses are\n// giant swoopers. The exit is locked until the boss dies.\nconst BOSS_SPECIES = ['slime', 'crawler', 'slider', 'scorpion', 'lavablob',\n  'bird', 'shroom', 'drone', 'golem', 'knight'];\n\nfunction makeBoss(stageIdx, p, arena) {\n  const sp = BOSS_SPECIES[((stageIdx % 10) + 10) % 10];\n  const base = SPECIES[sp](p);\n  const scale = 3;\n  const w = base.w * scale, h = base.h * scale;\n  const flying = sp === 'bird' || sp === 'drone';\n  const e = {\n    ...base, boss: true, bossScale: scale, w, h,\n    hp: 24 + Math.round(p * 36), dmg: Math.max(14, (base.dmg || 8) + 8),\n    x: Math.round(arena.x + arena.w * 0.6), dir: -1, phase: 0,\n    patrolMin: arena.x + 6, patrolMax: arena.x + arena.w - 6 - w,\n  };\n  if (flying) {\n    e.behavior = 'swoop'; e.air = true;\n    e.baseX = Math.round(arena.x + arena.w / 2);\n    e.baseY = Math.max(TOP + 50, arena.y - 215);\n    e.y = e.baseY;\n    e.swoopRange = 560; e.swoopSpeed = 300 + p * 90;\n  } else {\n    e.behavior = 'boss'; e.air = false;\n    e.y = arena.y - h;\n    e.baseY = arena.y - h;\n    e.speed = 60 + p * 60;\n    e.leapForce = 660; e.leapEvery = Math.max(1.3, 2.3 - p);\n  }\n  // Per-species special attack cooldowns\n  const SP_CD = { slime: 4.0, crawler: 5.0, slider: 3.5, scorpion: 4.2, lavablob: 3.0,\n                  bird: 4.0, shroom: 4.5, drone: 3.8, golem: 5.5, knight: 4.0 };\n  e._baseCD = SP_CD[sp] || 4.0;\n  e._specialCD = e._baseCD * 0.45; // first special fires sooner so players see it quickly\n  return e;\n}\n\nfunction mkP(x, y, w, type = 'normal') {\n  return { x: Math.round(x), y: Math.round(y), w: Math.max(40, Math.round(w)), h: 20, type };\n}\nfunction mkGround(x, w) {\n  return { x: Math.round(x), y: GROUND_Y, w: Math.max(1, Math.round(w)), h: GH - GROUND_Y, type: 'ground' };\n}\nfunction mkCoin(x, y, spin) {\n  return { x: Math.round(x), y: Math.round(y), collected: false, spinAngle: spin };\n}\n\nfunction nCoins(coins, plat, n, rng) {\n  const sp = plat.w / (n + 1);\n  for (let c = 0; c < n; c++) {\n    coins.push(mkCoin(plat.x + sp * (c + 1) - 8, plat.y - 36, rng() * Math.PI * 2));\n  }\n}\n\n// Parabolic arc of coins from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2), peaking upward by arcH px.\n// Doubles as a readable \"this is the path\" hint over every jump.\nfunction arcCoins(coins, x1, y1, x2, y2, n, rng, arcH = 55) {\n  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n    const t = (i + 1) / (n + 1);\n    const x = lerp(x1, x2, t) - 8;\n    const y = lerp(y1, y2, t) - arcH * Math.sin(Math.PI * t) - 8;\n    coins.push(mkCoin(x, y, rng() * Math.PI * 2));\n  }\n}\n\n// ─── BUILDER ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// A cursor that walks left→right. `x` is the right edge of the last placed\n// surface, `y` is the top of that surface (where the player would stand).\n// Segments append to it and leave the cursor on their final landing spot, so\n// any two segments connect cleanly — that's what gives levels a deliberate,\n// hand-built flow instead of one long random walk.\n\n// Place a single platform `gap` px past the cursor, at height `y`, with a coin\n// arc tracing the jump. Returns the platform.\nfunction connect(b, gap, y, w, type, arcH, coinN) {\n  y = clamp(y, TOP, FLOOR);\n  y = Math.max(y, b.y - MAX_RISE); // never demand more than one jump's worth of climb\n  if (b.low) y = Math.max(y, FLOOR - 175); // terrain stages: keep platforms near the ground\n  const fromX = b.x, fromY = b.y;\n  const pl = mkP(b.x + gap, y, w, type || 'normal');\n  b.plats.push(pl);\n  if (coinN > 0) arcCoins(b.coins, fromX, fromY, pl.x + pl.w / 2, y, coinN, b.rng, arcH == null ? 50 : arcH);\n  b.x = pl.x + pl.w; b.y = y;\n  return pl;\n}\n\n// Add a row of spikes. dir 'up' sits on a surface (jump over it); dir 'down'\n// hangs from a ceiling (don't jump into it).\nfunction addSpikes(b, x, topY, count, dir, size) {\n  size = size || 20;\n  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n    const y = dir === 'down' ? topY : topY - size;\n    b.hazards.push({ x: Math.round(x + i * size), y: Math.round(y), w: size, h: size, dir });\n  }\n}\n\n// ─── SEGMENTS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Each segment is one recognizable, intentional challenge. They are tuned by an\n// effective difficulty `e` (0..1) so the same segment reads as gentle early and\n// brutal late. Signature: (b, e).\n\n// Safe breather — used to pace the level so it has rhythm, not a wall of hazards.\nfunction segRest(b, e) {\n  const gap = lerp(70, 95, e);\n  const w = lerp(195, 150, e);\n  const y = clamp(b.y + (b.rng() - 0.5) * 36, TOP + 130, FLOOR);\n  const pl = connect(b, gap, y, w, 'normal', 38, 0);\n  nCoins(b.coins, pl, 3, b.rng);\n}\n\n// Rhythm jumps — evenly spaced equal platforms. Clean, metronomic.\nfunction segGapRun(b, e) {\n  const n = 3 + Math.floor(b.rng() * 3);\n  const gap = lerp(115, 200, e);\n  const w = lerp(135, 80, e);\n  const baseY = clamp(b.y - lerp(0, 45, e), TOP + 90, FLOOR);\n  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n    connect(b, gap + b.rng() * 18, baseY + (b.rng() - 0.5) * 32, w, 'normal', 52, 2);\n  }\n}\n\n// Ascending staircase — uniform steps, one coin per step.\nfunction segStairsUp(b, e) {\n  const n = 4 + Math.floor(b.rng() * 3);\n  const rise = lerp(48, 78, e);\n  const gap = lerp(78, 116, e);\n  const w = lerp(120, 74, e);\n  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) connect(b, gap, b.y - rise, w, 'normal', 28, 1);\n}\n\n// Descending staircase — quick drops are free, so this is a tempo break.\nfunction segStairsDown(b, e) {\n  const n = 4 + Math.floor(b.rng() * 3);\n  const drop = lerp(42, 92, e);\n  const gap = lerp(82, 124, e);\n  const w = lerp(122, 76, e);\n  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) connect(b, gap, b.y + drop, w, 'normal', 24, 1);\n}\n\n// Precision pillars — narrow posts alternating around a center line.\nfunction segPillars(b, e) {\n  const n = 4 + Math.floor(b.rng() * 4);\n  const w = lerp(74, 44, e);\n  const gap = lerp(96, 150, e);\n  const amp = lerp(28, 70, e);\n  const center = clamp(b.y - 18, TOP + 130, FLOOR - 40);\n  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n    connect(b, gap, center + (i % 2 ? amp : -amp), w, 'normal', 58, 1);\n  }\n}\n\n// Zigzag climb — alternating up/down while gaining altitude.\nfunction segZigzag(b, e) {\n  const n = 4 + Math.floor(b.rng() * 3);\n  const w = lerp(96, 60, e);\n  const gap = lerp(90, 140, e);\n  let up = true;\n  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n    const dy = up ? -lerp(40, 72, e) : lerp(20, 42, e);\n    connect(b, gap, b.y + dy, w, 'normal', 54, 1);\n    up = !up;\n  }\n}\n\n// Long leaps — a couple of near-max double-jump gaps with a fat coin trail.\nfunction segLongLeap(b, e) {\n  const n = 2 + Math.floor(b.rng() * 2);\n  const gap = lerp(185, 248, e);\n  const w = lerp(140, 92, e);\n  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n    connect(b, gap + b.rng() * 8, b.y + (b.rng() - 0.5) * 56, w, 'normal', 82, 4);\n  }\n}\n\n// Descent shaft — controlled drop down a stack of ledges.\nfunction segDescentDrop(b, e) {\n  const n = 2 + Math.floor(b.rng() * 2);\n  const w = lerp(112, 72, e);\n  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n    connect(b, lerp(58, 92, e), b.y + lerp(70, 120, e), w, 'normal', 22, 1);\n  }\n}\n\n// Ground run studded with spike clusters you must hop over.\nfunction segSpikePath(b, e) {\n  connect(b, lerp(42, 72, e), FLOOR, 92, 'normal', 30, 1); // step down to ground level\n  const runLen = lerp(520, 820, e);\n  const gx = b.x + 8;\n  b.plats.push(mkGround(gx, runLen));\n  const clusters = 2 + Math.floor(e * 3 + b.rng() * 2);\n  for (let k = 0; k < clusters; k++) {\n    const cxk = gx + runLen * (k + 1) / (clusters + 1) - 20;\n    const cnt = 1 + Math.floor(e * 2 + b.rng() * 2);\n    addSpikes(b, cxk, GROUND_Y, cnt, 'up', 20);\n    arcCoins(b.coins, cxk - 22, GROUND_Y - 20, cxk + cnt * 20 + 22, GROUND_Y - 20, 3, b.rng, 62);\n  }\n  b.x = gx + runLen; b.y = GROUND_Y;\n}\n\n// Horizontal moving platform ferrying you across a void. Timing puzzle.\nfunction segMovingBridge(b, e) {\n  connect(b, lerp(80, 110, e), b.y + (b.rng() - 0.5) * 28, lerp(120, 90, e), 'normal', 40, 1);\n  const range = lerp(140, 240, e);\n  const mw = lerp(96, 64, e);\n  const my = clamp(b.y + (b.rng() - 0.5) * 18, TOP + 80, FLOOR);\n  const baseX = b.x + lerp(40, 70, e);\n  const mp = mkP(baseX, my, mw, 'move');\n  mp.move = { axis: 'x', baseX, baseY: my, max: baseX + range, speed: lerp(1.4, 2.4, e), phase: b.rng() * 6.28 };\n  b.plats.push(mp);\n  const landX = baseX + range + lerp(150, 230, e);\n  const ly = clamp(my + (b.rng() - 0.5) * 28, TOP + 80, FLOOR);\n  const lp = mkP(landX, ly, lerp(130, 92, e), 'normal');\n  b.plats.push(lp);\n  arcCoins(b.coins, baseX, my, landX, ly, 4, b.rng, 50);\n  nCoins(b.coins, lp, 2, b.rng);\n  b.x = lp.x + lp.w; b.y = ly;\n}\n\n// Vertical elevator lifting you up a shaft to a higher ledge.\nfunction segElevator(b, e) {\n  connect(b, lerp(80, 110, e), Math.min(FLOOR, b.y + lerp(0, 40, e)), lerp(120, 90, e), 'normal', 40, 1);\n  const bottom = b.y;\n  const rise = lerp(120, 205, e);\n  const top = clamp(bottom - rise, TOP + 40, FLOOR);\n  const mw = lerp(102, 70, e);\n  const baseX = b.x + lerp(50, 80, e);\n  const mp = mkP(baseX, bottom, mw, 'move');\n  mp.move = { axis: 'y', baseX, baseY: bottom, max: top, speed: lerp(1.0, 1.7, e), phase: 0 };\n  b.plats.push(mp);\n  const lp = mkP(baseX + mw + lerp(40, 70, e), top, lerp(122, 86, e), 'normal');\n  b.plats.push(lp);\n  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {\n    b.coins.push(mkCoin(baseX + mw / 2 - 8, bottom - (i + 1) * (rise / 5), b.rng() * 6.28));\n  }\n  nCoins(b.coins, lp, 2, b.rng);\n  b.x = lp.x + lp.w; b.y = top;\n}\n\n// Low corridor with ceiling spikes — a single jump clears each gap, but a\n// double jump skewers you. Punishes panic-jumping.\nfunction segGauntlet(b, e) {\n  const n = 3 + Math.floor(b.rng() * 2);\n  const w = lerp(112, 78, e);\n  const gap = lerp(80, 120, e);\n  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n    const pl = connect(b, gap, clamp(b.y + (b.rng() - 0.5) * 18, FLOOR - 70, FLOOR), w, 'normal', 26, 1);\n    const ceilY = pl.y - lerp(178, 150, e); // high enough that a single jump clears, a double doesn't\n    addSpikes(b, pl.x + 6, ceilY, Math.max(2, Math.floor(pl.w / 20) - 1), 'down', 18);\n  }\n}\n\n// Crumbling platforms that fall away seconds after you touch them — keep moving.\nfunction segCrumbleRun(b, e) {\n  const n = 3 + Math.floor(b.rng() * 3);\n  const w = lerp(98, 66, e);\n  const gap = lerp(95, 148, e);\n  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n    connect(b, gap, b.y + (b.rng() - 0.5) * 28, w, 'crumble', 50, 1);\n  }\n  connect(b, gap, b.y, lerp(122, 92, e), 'normal', 40, 2); // solid landing to recover\n}\n\n// One big leap over an open spike pit — miss and you're impaled.\nfunction segSpikeLeap(b, e) {\n  connect(b, lerp(80, 110, e), b.y, lerp(110, 82, e), 'normal', 28, 1);\n  const gap = lerp(190, 250, e);\n  const pitX = b.x + 30;\n  const pitW = gap - 30;\n  const sCount = Math.max(2, Math.floor(pitW / 22));\n  addSpikes(b, pitX, GROUND_Y, sCount, 'up', 22);\n  connect(b, gap, b.y + (b.rng() - 0.5) * 28, lerp(122, 92, e), 'normal', 86, 4);\n}\n\n// Reward vault — a wide safe platform with a patterned coin payout. Adds\n// authored \"set piece\" flavor and a moment to breathe.\nfunction segCoinVault(b, e) {\n  const pl = connect(b, lerp(70, 100, e), clamp(b.y + (b.rng() - 0.5) * 28, TOP + 130, FLOOR), lerp(210, 160, e), 'normal', 40, 0);\n  arcCoins(b.coins, pl.x + 12, pl.y - 8, pl.x + pl.w - 12, pl.y - 8, 6, b.rng, 72);\n  nCoins(b.coins, pl, 4, b.rng);\n}\n\n// Final approach — a generous platform that hosts the exit door.\nfunction segFinish(b) {\n  const pl = connect(b, 105, clamp(b.y, TOP + 130, FLOOR), 210, 'normal', 45, 0);\n  nCoins(b.coins, pl, 5, b.rng);\n}\n\n// ─── SEGMENT TABLE & SELECTION ───────────────────────────────────────────────\n// tier: 0 easy, 1 medium, 2 hard. gate: minimum global progress before a\n// mechanic is allowed to appear (so stage 1 doesn't open with crumble + spikes).\nconst SEGMENTS = [\n  { id: 'gap', fn: segGapRun, tier: 0, gate: 0 },\n  { id: 'stairsUp', fn: segStairsUp, tier: 0, gate: 0 },\n  { id: 'stairsDown', fn: segStairsDown, tier: 0, gate: 0 },\n  { id: 'coinVault', fn: segCoinVault, tier: 0, gate: 0 },\n  { id: 'pillars', fn: segPillars, tier: 1, gate: 0 },\n  { id: 'zigzag', fn: segZigzag, tier: 1, gate: 0 },\n  { id: 'longLeap', fn: segLongLeap, tier: 1, gate: 0 },\n  { id: 'descent', fn: segDescentDrop, tier: 1, gate: 0 },\n  { id: 'spikePath', fn: segSpikePath, tier: 1, gate: 0.03 },\n  { id: 'movingBridge', fn: segMovingBridge, tier: 2, gate: 0.06 },\n  { id: 'elevator', fn: segElevator, tier: 2, gate: 0.06 },\n  { id: 'gauntlet', fn: segGauntlet, tier: 2, gate: 0.10 },\n  { id: 'crumble', fn: segCrumbleRun, tier: 2, gate: 0.16 },\n  { id: 'spikeLeap', fn: segSpikeLeap, tier: 2, gate: 0.20 },\n];\n\nfunction pickSegment(b, e, last, prof) {\n  const allow = prof && prof.pool;\n  const ok = s => b.p >= s.gate && s.fn !== last && (!allow || allow.includes(s.id));\n  const desired = e < 0.34 ? 0 : e < 0.66 ? 1 : 2;\n  let pool = SEGMENTS.filter(s => ok(s) && s.tier <= desired && s.tier >= desired - 1);\n  if (!pool.length) pool = SEGMENTS.filter(s => ok(s) && s.tier <= desired);\n  if (!pool.length) pool = SEGMENTS.filter(s => b.p >= s.gate && (!allow || allow.includes(s.id)));\n  if (!pool.length) pool = SEGMENTS.filter(s => b.p >= s.gate);\n  if (!pool.length) pool = [SEGMENTS[0]];\n  return pool[Math.floor(b.rng() * pool.length)];\n}\n\n// ─── LEVEL ASSEMBLY ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Builds the level as an intentional arc: warm-up → escalating challenges\n// (paced with breathers) → a hard climax → the exit approach. Difficulty ramps\n// both across the 500 levels (global `p`) and within each level (local `e`).\nfunction buildLevel(rng, p, stageIdx) {\n  const prof = getProfile(stageIdx);\n  const b = { rng, p, x: 220, y: FLOOR, plats: [], coins: [], hazards: [], low: !!prof.low };\n\n  // Gentle on-ramp for the opening levels: the first ~15 levels (the start of\n  // Meadow) begin short and easy, then ramp up to the full length/difficulty\n  // curve. `introT` is 0 on level 1 and reaches 1 by ~level 16.\n  const idx = Math.round(p * 499);            // global level index 0..499\n  const introT = clamp(idx / 15, 0, 1);\n  const baseW = lerp(5500, 24000, p);         // full-curve length for this progress\n  const targetW = lerp(1800, baseW, introT);  // much shorter while easing in\n\n  // Boss levels: every 10th level (10/20/30/40/50 of each stage) is a short\n  // approach into a very large arena platform holding the stage boss. The exit\n  // stays locked until the boss is defeated (gated in entities.js/main.js).\n  if (idx % 10 === 9) {\n    segRest(b, 0.15);\n    const seg = pickSegment(b, 0.3, null, prof);\n    seg.fn(b, 0.3);\n    segRest(b, 0.2);\n    const arena = mkP(b.x + 100, clamp(b.y + 40, TOP + 150, FLOOR), 1150, 'normal');\n    b.plats.push(arena);\n    arcCoins(b.coins, b.x, b.y, arena.x + 90, arena.y, 3, rng, 55);\n    b.x = arena.x + arena.w; b.y = arena.y;\n    b.arena = arena;\n    segFinish(b);\n    return b;\n  }\n\n  segRest(b, 0.08); // gentle landing right after the start pad\n\n  let last = null;\n  let sinceRest = 0;\n  let guard = 0;\n  while (b.x < targetW - 900 && guard++ < 600) {\n    const f = clamp(b.x / targetW, 0, 1);\n    const localE = lerp(0.12, 1.0, f);\n    let e = clamp(p * 0.45 + localE * 0.55, 0, 1);\n    e *= 0.5 + 0.5 * introT; // hold the opening levels down in the easy tier\n\n    // Insert a breather every few segments so the level has rhythm.\n    if (sinceRest >= 2 + Math.floor(rng() * 2)) {\n      segRest(b, e); sinceRest = 0; continue;\n    }\n\n    const seg = pickSegment(b, e, last, prof);\n    seg.fn(b, e);\n    last = seg.fn;\n    sinceRest++;\n  }\n\n  // Climax: a deliberately hard set piece right before the finish — but eased\n  // way down during the on-ramp, and skipped entirely on the first few levels\n  // so they stay short and end gently instead of on a wall.\n  if (introT >= 0.2) {\n    const climaxE = clamp((p * 0.5 + 0.88) * (0.35 + 0.65 * introT), 0, 1);\n    const climax = pickSegment(b, climaxE, last, prof);\n    climax.fn(b, climaxE);\n  }\n\n  segFinish(b);\n  return b;\n}\n\n// ─── ENEMY PLACEMENT ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Scatters enemies across the finished geometry. Ground-bound foes patrol the\n// platform they spawn on; flyers hover in wide gaps. Count, HP and type variety\n// all scale with global progress `p`, and the start pad + exit platform stay\n// clear so spawns and finishes are safe.\nfunction makeGroundFoe(pl, rng, p, roster) {\n  if (!roster.ground.length) return null;\n  const base = SPECIES[pickSpecies(roster.ground, rng)](p);\n  if (pl.w < base.w + 24) return null; // platform too small to patrol\n  const min = pl.x + 4;\n  const max = pl.x + pl.w - 4 - base.w;\n  const e = {\n    ...base, x: Math.round(lerp(min, max, rng())), y: Math.round(pl.y - base.h),\n    dir: rng() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1, phase: rng() * 6.28,\n    patrolMin: Math.round(min), patrolMax: Math.round(max),\n  };\n  if (base.behavior === 'hop') e.baseY = e.y;\n  if (base.behavior === 'shoot') { e.patrolMin = e.patrolMax = e.x; } // emplaced gun\n  return e;\n}\n\nfunction placeEnemies(platforms, rng, p, exitPlat, stageIdx) {\n  const prof = getProfile(stageIdx);\n  const roster = STAGE_ROSTER[((stageIdx % 10) + 10) % 10];\n  const enemies = [];\n  if (p < 0.012) return enemies; // very first level stays enemy-free\n  const density = lerp(0.12, 0.6, p);\n  const CAP = 46;\n  const exitCx = exitPlat.x + exitPlat.w / 2;\n\n  // Builders for air dwellers (hover over gaps) and hang species (anchored\n  // above a walkway: falling icicles, thread spiders).\n  const mkAir = (sp, midX, baseY, gap) => {\n    const base = SPECIES[sp](p);\n    const e = {\n      ...base, x: Math.round(midX), y: Math.round(baseY),\n      dir: 1, phase: rng() * 6.28, patrolMin: 0, patrolMax: 0,\n      baseX: Math.round(midX), baseY: Math.round(baseY),\n    };\n    if (base.behavior === 'fly') {\n      e.ampX = Math.min(gap * 0.3, 120); e.ampY = lerp(15, 42, p);\n      e.sx = 0.8 + rng() * 0.9; e.sy = 1.4 + rng() * 1.1;\n    }\n    return e;\n  };\n  const mkHang = (sp, cx, platTop) => {\n    const base = SPECIES[sp](p);\n    const anchorY = Math.round(clamp(platTop - lerp(160, 215, rng()), TOP + 8, platTop - 120));\n    return {\n      ...base, x: Math.round(cx - base.w / 2), y: anchorY,\n      dir: 1, phase: rng() * 6.28, patrolMin: 0, patrolMax: 0,\n      baseX: Math.round(cx), baseY: anchorY, anchorY,\n      dropY: Math.round(platTop - base.h - 6),\n    };\n  };\n\n  // Ground patrollers on solid platforms / ground runs.\n  for (const pl of platforms) {\n    if (enemies.length >= CAP || !roster.ground.length) break;\n    if (pl === exitPlat) continue;\n    if (pl.type === 'move' || pl.type === 'crumble') continue; // unstable footing\n    if (pl.type !== 'ground' && pl.type !== 'normal') continue;\n\n    // A wide continuous floor (grounded stages) gets several foes spaced along it\n    // rather than a single one, so terrain levels feel populated.\n    if (pl.type === 'ground' && pl.w > 360) {\n      const slots = Math.min(8, Math.floor(pl.w / 360));\n      for (let s = 0; s < slots && enemies.length < CAP; s++) {\n        const cx = pl.x + pl.w * (s + 0.5) / slots;\n        if (cx < 340) continue;                          // keep the opening safe\n        if (Math.abs(cx - exitCx) < 200) continue;        // keep the finish safe\n        if (rng() >= density) continue;\n        const e = makeGroundFoe({ x: Math.round(cx - 60), y: pl.y, w: 120 }, rng, p, roster);\n        if (e) enemies.push(e);\n      }\n      continue;\n    }\n\n    if (pl.x < 320) continue;            // keep the opening safe\n    if (pl.w < 50) continue;\n    if (rng() >= density) continue;\n    const e = makeGroundFoe(pl, rng, p, roster);\n    if (e) enemies.push(e);\n  }\n\n  // Hang species anchored above walkways (drop on / descend at the player).\n  if (roster.hang.length) {\n    for (const pl of platforms) {\n      if (enemies.length >= CAP) break;\n      if (pl === exitPlat) continue;\n      if (pl.type === 'ground' && pl.w > 480) {\n        const slots = Math.min(6, Math.floor(pl.w / 480));\n        for (let s = 0;
